name: Beat-Cards
description: One concise card per beat, with a rapid sequence of clear interface-card layouts. Adapted to full-screen explainer scenes in montage-v2.
render_scope: Style is applied to HyperFrames full-screen slide_full scenes. Talking-head, subtitle and B-roll layers retain the reference montage treatment; this engine does not render Remotion mascot or virtual-camera compositions.
